format: html

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
schema(open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet"))
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  slice_sample(n = 10)
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarize(avg_market_cap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  write_dataset("data/prices_by_coin", existing_data_behavior = "overwrite")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(categories, by = "category_id", suffix = c("_coin", "_category")) |>
  mutate(date = as_date(date_raw))
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("ymd", "mdy")) |> as_date())

metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = 22)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date_raw),
    market_cap_trillions = market_cap_usd / 1e12
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = market_cap_trillions)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Market Cap Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market Cap (Trillions USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(market_cap_usd > 0) |>
  mutate(market_cap_billions = market_cap_usd / 1e9) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = market_cap_billions, y = fct_reorder(coin_id, market_cap_billions, median, na.rm = TRUE))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Market Cap Distribution Across Coins",
    x = "Market Cap (Billions USD, Log Scale)",
    y = "Coin"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(total_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Crypto Market Cap Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Market Cap (Trillions USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(total_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE) / 1e12, .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap, color = category_name)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market Cap Over Time by Category",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market Cap (Trillions USD)",
    color = "Category"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(total_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, total_market_cap, sum, .desc = TRUE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2022-05-09"), linetype = "dashed", color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = as_date("2022-05-09"), y = 0.98, label = "Luna/UST Crash", hjust = 1.05, vjust = 1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = as_date("2022-11-08"), linetype = "dashed", color = "white", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = as_date("2022-11-08"), y = 0.98, label = "FTX Collapse", hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "Cryptocurrency Market Cap Share by Category",
    subtitle = "Daily percentage share of total market capitalization across major crypto categories",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Total Market Capitalization",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: CoinGecko via PPBDS"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
